title: French Language – Level 02
overview: French Language – Level 02 builds on foundational French skills and develops the ability to communicate in familiar social, travel, and routine workplace situations. Learners extend their control of everyday grammar, acquire broader functional vocabulary, and practise producing connected sentences through guided conversations, short readings, listening tasks, and practical writing. The course emphasizes intelligible pronunciation, confidence, and accurate communication at an elementary level.
audience: Learners who have completed French Language – Level 01 or possess equivalent beginner proficiency; students, professionals, travelers, and individuals seeking to improve practical French for everyday and basic workplace interactions.
methodology: Interactive instructor-led lessons; communicative pair and group activities; pronunciation and listening drills; guided dialogues and role plays; reading and writing exercises; vocabulary recycling; short presentations; formative quizzes; and practical end-of-course speaking and writing assessments.
competencies: Elementary conversational fluency and listening comprehension in familiar contexts.
Use of common past, present, and near-future expressions.
Functional vocabulary for travel, shopping, work, health, and daily routines.
Reading short authentic texts and writing clear connected messages.
Pronunciation, question formation, and socially appropriate interaction.
Independent use of clarification and communication-repair strategies.
objectives: Exchange information about daily activities, experiences, plans, and preferences.
Ask and answer questions using a wider range of structures and expressions.
Describe recent events using introductory past-tense constructions.
Discuss intentions and arrangements using the near future.
Understand the main points of short, clearly delivered everyday conversations.
Read practical notices, schedules, messages, and simple descriptive texts.
Write short emails, invitations, descriptions, and personal updates.
Use appropriate language for routine customer and workplace encounters.
Improve pronunciation, fluency, and accuracy through guided practice.
